question: How long does subjugation last when applied in matters of food and drink?
premises: The practice is applied in rules concerning food and eatables.
The subjugated person goes along with their lineage.
inference: When applied in matters of food and drink, the person and their lineage come under subjugation until death.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of sa+anvayāti as a single token is ambiguous.
plain_english: When applied in the rules of food and eatables, he goes under subjugation with his lineage until death.
